propositions: Cloud probe hardcodes RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES to frozenset({'Resolved','Done','Cancelled'}), whereas DC reconciler reads resolved_statuses from config, causing parity gap.
Tenants with non-standard workflow status names (e.g. 'Closed', 'Complete') have issues misclassified as PRESENT_FILTERED instead of PRESENT_RESOLVED with no configuration option to correct it.
Cloud probe should source resolved_statuses from JiraConfig at runtime, defaulting to the current three hardcoded names, mirroring DC's ReconcilerConfig.resolved_statuses behavior.
An explicitly empty or unset resolved_statuses config should fall back to the module-level default rather than bind an empty set, preserving backward compatibility for stock tenants.

Custom resolved_statuses config must be consulted exclusively (not merged with defaults), so a tenant specifying ['Closed','Complete'] classifies 'Done' as PRESENT_FILTERED and 'Closed' as PRESENT_RESOLVED.
